newsitem.title: USA: DynEco Corp says CEO, directors resign.
newsitem.headline: DynEco Corp says CEO, directors resign.

text.p: DynEco Corp said Wednesday its chief executive officer, Richard Besser, resigned last week after most of the company's directors resigned.
The lone remaining director, co-founder Thomas Edwards, has assumed the role of acting chief executive officer, the company said.
The resignations were related to disputes with respect to the status of the assignment of Edwards' intellectual property rights to DynEco, the company said. Edwards was not available to elaborate.
Edwards said in a statement that an interim board of directors will be appointed to be followed with the election of a new board of directors at DynEco's forthcoming annual meeting of shareholders.
DynEco, based in Rockledge, Florida, designs, develops and licenses a variety of advanced compressor technologies for commercial, industrial, and selected consumer related markets.
